title: Four Inks
summary: Ten weeks of studio work, measured in process ink and drawn as a grid of dots.
subject: Information Design
coverAlt: Poster with a grid of large cyan, magenta, yellow and black circles surrounded by small dots

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: Collect your own data for a full quarter. Design a poster that lets a stranger see the pattern before they read the legend.

blocks.heading: The data
blocks.body: I logged every print I made over one quarter by its dominant ink, cyan, magenta, yellow or black. Each large circle is one studio day. The small dots around it are the individual prints.

blocks.label: Raw data. A screenshot of the spreadsheet, showing the categories you tracked.
Rejected directions. Sketches of the chart types you tried and dropped, with a note on why.

blocks.caption: Up close, each small dot is one print.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: Magenta dominates the first weeks and black takes over by midterm, when my work moved toward type. I didn’t notice that shift until the poster showed it to me.
